description.en: Resumable JavaScript workflows with native subagents, nested calls, token budgets and worktree isolation for DSH 0.2.1-rc.2. Distributed as dsh-workflow-plus through GitHub Releases; no npm package.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 的可恢复 JavaScript 工作流，支持原生子智能体、嵌套调用、token 预算和 worktree 隔离。包名 dsh-workflow-plus，通过 GitHub Release 分发，未发布 npm。
